text_block_list.text:
The Nikkei Shinshun Hai is today.
Мэйсё Дото
timidly steps up to her first
self-initiated
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Determined to become capable of
supporting
Т.М. Опера О, she presses
forward with the
well-wishes of her best
friend,
Matikanefukukitaru.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
